laws.typed_state: search state identity retains anchor bindings obligations context evidence epoch boundary heuristic and depth; endpoint identity alone cannot define state equivalence
laws.typed_transition: each transition retains relation family source layer direction law evidence root receipt and independently weighted cost components
laws.astar: an A-star claim orders by checked accumulated plus remaining cost and requires a nonzero admissibility proof; inconsistent heuristics require reopen semantics
laws.dominance: frontier dominance is program-scoped and preserves every Pareto-feasible accumulated-cost and remaining-depth label rather than collapsing by endpoint
laws.frontier: providers expand bounded frontier batches and cannot decide semantic completion by returning a nonempty row or nearest candidate
laws.evidence: path evidence counts unique eligible dependence roots; repeated descendants cannot multiply independent support
laws.answerability: a found path is reachability and an upper bound unless the selected boundary and requested proof obligations permit completion or optimal certification
laws.resources: every execution is bounded by explicit state transition frontier memory IO database provider and depth budgets and returns a typed limiting disposition
laws.replay: program inputs provider receipts accepted transitions path selection and final disposition are deterministically receipted
